method: Read-only current recording/capture/Windows pipe source review against retained native run evidence; no optimization implemented or hardware test dispatched.

source_observations.observed: Each admitted capture creates a PBO; successful poll copies mapped bytes into a fresh bytearray then deletes PBO/fence.
source_observations.candidate: Reuse bounded GL readback buffers; profile mapping/copy/allocation separately.

source_observations.observed: complete_capture copies pixels again with bytearray(pixels); normalization swaps rows through native NumPy copies.
source_observations.candidate: Explicit owned-buffer handoff to avoid the second copy; retain borrowing safety. Evaluate orientation correction during GPU composition with identical final pixels.

source_observations.observed: begin_write owns a copied backing buffer until overlapped completion.
source_observations.candidate: A lifetime-bound borrowed/owned write interface could avoid another copy, keeping data pinned and immutable until cancellation/completion is proven.

source_observations.observed: Recording loop handles queued evidence before encoder draining and uses5ms condition polling waits.
source_observations.candidate: Measure completion-to-next-service delay; evaluate event notification and fair bounded evidence/encoder service without weakening required logging or closure deadlines.

profiling_needed: each CPU copy and row normalization
NVENC utilization/capacity and storage writes under three-camera load
engineering_target: Maintain60Hz presentation; demonstrate at least72fps capacity for throughput-limiting recording stages where independently measurable, then size outstanding-slot demand times1.2. Neither source review nor larger slots proves that target.
quality_policy: Prioritize overhead removal preserving resolution, orientation, precision, color sampling, rate, exact frame accounting and GPU ownership. Preset/quality/workload changes require separate measured comparisons.
